# Yapern

> An open source sub-yap with sub-yaps and community moderators.

- Homepage: https://yapern.com/
- About: https://yapern.com/about/
- Blog: https://yapern.com/blog/
- Source code: https://github.com/yapern/web
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL v3)
- Backend: Yapern API, https://api.yapern.com/docs

The homepage includes an interactive preview with sample posts. Preview interactions are local to the page and do not connect to a live sub-yap.
